acceptanceCriteria: A changed line whose text repeats elsewhere in the file can be cited when the hunk pins its position, or the refusal suggests a unique line in the same hunk.
A test covers a repeated table-separator span.
body: Friction from V1-1528 (PR #998): the dogfood citation-plan cite-stability check refused a hunk span whose text (`|---|---|---|`) occurs more than once in the changed file, so the lane had to cite a different unique line instead of the changed one. Expected: a span inside the hunk is accepted when its position is pinned by the hunk (or the refusal names a unique alternative line), so table edits can be cited directly.
title: dogfood cite-stability refuses a citation span whose text repeats in the changed file (e.g. a markdown table separator row)
